bio.text: Alex Holladay, a Democrat, represents Arkansas House District 70, which includes portions of North Little Rock and Sherwood, and is serving his first term.
He is a program manager at UAMS and previously worked with National Guard members on higher education and career pathways.

Holladay earned a Bachelor of Arts in communication from the University of Oklahoma and a Master of Science in sports management from the University of Arkansas at Little Rock, and lives in North Little Rock.
